label: Diagram 15
caption: Diagram 15 An example of wheelchair space provision in a cinema or theatre
description: A plan of part of a cinema or theatre showing wheelchair space provision. Rows of seats run up the page, with 'Steps' in the aisles. Beside the last row, two wheelchair users sit in dashed '1400mm x 900mm nominal wheelchair spaces', one behind the other. Above them, a hatched 'Rostrum' holds more seats: 'The rostrum as well as seats on the rostrum and seats in the next row can be removed to create more wheelchair spaces'. Two dimensions run from the seating towards the 'Rear wall': '1100mm*' to the back of the wheelchairs, then '900mm' to the rear wall. A door is in the wall at the bottom right. Note: '* Dimension derived from BS 8300'.
model_description:
This diagram shows a plan view of an example of wheelchair space provision in a cinema or theatre. It depicts rows of seats, a rostrum, a rear wall, and two wheelchair spaces.

The seating is arranged in rows, with vertical lines representing aisles and 'Steps' indicated at the bottom of two aisles. At the top right, there is a hatched area labeled 'Rostrum'. Adjacent to the rostrum, a dashed rectangle outlines two wheelchair spaces. Each space contains a top-down symbol of a person in a wheelchair. A text note states: 'The rostrum as well as seats on the rostrum and seats in the next row can be removed to create more wheelchair spaces'.

The wheelchair spaces are labeled '1400mm x 900mm nominal wheelchair spaces'. A horizontal dimension line shows the width of one wheelchair space as '900mm' and the total width of both spaces plus the gap as '1100mm*'. A note at the bottom specifies: '* Dimension derived from BS 8300'. The 'Rear wall' is indicated by a thin line with an arrow pointing to it, located behind the wheelchair spaces.
